messages:
Jordan: quick ping — PR #23720 is ready for merge but needs cross-team eyes (runtime, infra, security). Can we get approvals + a merge slot tomorrow morning? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/23720
Sam: @Jordan looking. Which parts are most important for runtime review?
Jordan: the KV fallback change + small kernel selector tweak. Canary plan in PR description: 5%/30m -> 25%/1h -> 100%. Target qps ~300 steady, spikes up to ~800 during rollout.
Sam: ok will run perf against the canary config today, should have numbers in a couple hours.
Maria: tagging infra — @Priya heads up the eviction header change touches the autoscaler config.
Priya: can you paste the config diff here? quick scan first.
Jordan: snippet:
```
- eviction_threshold: 0.85
+ eviction_threshold: 0.9
+ enable_fallback: true
```
Jordan: also added a fallback routing policy that prefers older-ready replicas for short lived requests.
Sam: ran a quick local perf for seq=2048, p99 went +3% and tail slightly noisier. uploading artifacts to the PR now. Link in comments.
Priya: that +3% is fine if we have the same perf in canary. One ask: update ops runbook and terraform var default for eviction_threshold before merge. I can approve infra once that's in.
Alex: security note: static scan flagged a new header `X-deploy-meta` exposed to upstream. Need to scrub sensitive bits. I'll put a small sanitization patch on the branch unless you already have it.
Jordan: not yet, please add it to the same branch. Thanks.
infra-bot: autoscaler: suppressing eviction alerts for rollout window 2168893200-2168896800 per request. :white_check_mark:
Sam: perf artifacts uploaded, regression is within acceptable limits and unit tests pass. runtime approved from my side.
Alex: pushed sanitization patch and ran SCA again — clean. security approved.
Priya: added runbook note + terraform var update in a follow-up commit. infra approved.
Jordan: awesome — can someone take the merge slot tomorrow at 10:00 UTC? I need a pair to watch metrics during canary.
Sam: I can take merge duty at 10:00 UTC and monitor.
Jordan: perfect — scheduling canary and will post dashboard links. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
